summary: Iteration 8 frontend-only testing complete. Verified favorites totals summary box, interactive shopping list check-off with strikethrough, substitution hints, and WhatsApp share button. All new features work as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: RecipeCard.jsx is ~470 lines — still manageable but approaching split threshold. Consider extracting ShoppingList into its own subcomponent.

buildShoppingText emoji encoding: leading '🛒' emoji renders as '%EF%BF%BD' (replacement char) in the wa.me URL in some environments — likely a UTF-8/encoding edge case observed during Playwright encoding. In browser it renders correctly, but worth verifying UTF-8 handling of encodeURIComponent + emoji in tested runtime.
seed_data_creation: Seeded localStorage 'zsc_favorites' with 2 test recipes (r1 impact 550g/€3.5, r2 impact 400g/€2.2) via page.evaluate to test totals sum (~950 g, ~5,70 €) and shopping features.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Iteration 8 features verified: (1) favorites-totals box sums correctly with Italian formatting (~950 g, ~5,70 €), (2) totals box is hidden when localStorage cleared, (3) shopping-item-toggle toggles line-through/green state on/off, (4) substitution-hint rendered for items with matching substitutions (Parmigiano→Grana Padano), (5) share-shopping-button opens a popup with wa.me URL (redirects to api.whatsapp.com/send on desktop — this is WhatsApp's standard behavior, not a bug). No regressions observed in Favorites open->RecipeCard modal flow.
